summary: RTP allows header extensions, but it was hard to use many of them. This document provides a general mechanism for using a small number of small extensions in each RTP packet, where many extensions are possible and registration is decentralized. Which ones are in use is negotiated per session.

eli5.summary: It gives each audio or video packet a few tiny optional sticky notes, and the two sides agree beforehand which notes they will use.

questions: how do rtp header extensions work
